senses.gloss:
मेखला मेखला, f.
 1. A girdle, Ragh. 8, 63; Utt. Rāmac. 106, 1.
 2. The sacrificial string, see कृ with मेखला.
 3. A sword-belt.
 4. A swordknot.
 5. The slope of a mountain, Megh. 12.
 6. The Narmadā river.
 --Comp.
मेखलिन् मेखलिन्, i. e. मेखला + इन्, adj. f. नी, Wearing a girdle, Pañc. iii. d. 237.
